text:
nina: FYI planning to push a controlled rollout of config.runtime.route_bias to shift 15% of noisy tenants off low-latency pools. want the console to expose a 'Preflight + Simulate' that returns a compact impact report before apply. cc @rahul @eva
rahul: +1. product asks for a single-button preflight that runs a simulated decision pass, shows quota headroom, and flags top customers that cross thresholds. can we include an approval checkbox for compliance?
eva: telemetry asks: emit config.rollout.simulated.requests, include sampled traces (sample_rate=0.4) and a small cost-estimate per-tenant. also add an audit-log entry with config_version and operator id.
charlie: strongly recommend a rate-limited progression: 15% -> 35% -> 70% -> 100% with backoff if p95 increases >10% vs baseline. put an automatic circuit-breaker that pauses and tags owners.
nina: backend proposal: POST /api/configs/simulate_apply?simulate=true with payload; response is a flat report string we can render in UI. curl example: `curl -X POST /api/configs/simulate_apply?simulate=true -d '{"key":"config.runtime.route_bias","value":0.15,"stages":[{"pct":15}]}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"`
ops-bot: deploybot: synthetic-sim job queued (sim-774). ETA ~6m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
rahul: UI detail: show preflight card with estimated qps shift, estimated cost delta, top-10 affected tenants, and a binary risk flag (ok/warn). include an 'Approve & Apply' toggle that requires a comment for audit.
audit-bot: audit: preflight requested by nina for config.runtime.route_bias v23. Preflight ID sim-774 logged.
eva: for tracing, please attach a canary header x-rw-sim-id and log mapping sim-id -> config_version so we can fetch traces quickly. also recommend a metric config.rollout.error.rate and a diff metric config.rollout.p95.delta.
charlie: playbook: how to pause, pin fallback route, and force rollback. example pause command: `curl -X POST /api/configs/pause -d '{"key":"config.runtime.route_bias","version":23}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"` rollback quick example: `curl -X POST /api/configs/apply -d '{"key":"config.runtime.route_bias","value":0.0}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"`
rahul: also add a temporary SLO for the sim: p95 <= baseline * 1.10 for the canary window. if violated for >10m, auto-pause and notify owners. tag incidents with sim-id.
nina: schedule: kick off preflight sim at 21:00 PT, run synthetic for 10m, review report, then if green start staged rollout with 20m observation windows. i'll post status here.
eva: will wire dashboards and add the sim panel. will surface top tenant rows and cost deltas.
ops-bot: monitorbot: synthetic sim-774 started. logs: /infra/jobs/sim-774/logs
charlie: LGTM. if the preflight shows concentrated customer impact we should require manual approval to proceed.
rahul: agreed. making the approval required for any preflight that lists >3 enterprise customers impacted.
nina: thanks all. pushing the preflight to console now. will wait for the sim report and thumbs before applying. :rocket:
